en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3081 - Al-Halabi narrated from Imam (as) that he said:

"A Jew or a Christian should not slaughter your sacrificial animal for you. If it is a woman, she should slaughter for herself, face the Qiblah, and say:
'
I have turned my face towards the One who created the heavens and the earth, inclining to the truth,
as a submitter [to Allah (swt)]. O Allah (swt), this is from You and for You.'"
